text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-81342 fired for service=inference-hosting (us-west-2). Symptom: sustained p99 latency > 3.0s over 5m. SLO burn: 12% (p95 healthy, tail rising). Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-81342

pagerduty-bot: paging jordan (oncall) and rotation team.

jordan: taking the page, acked in PD. Looking at traces now.

matt: ack. telemetry shows kvcache miss rate spiked ~10x at 14:10 UTC, sidecar queue depth growing. Any config pushes in last hour?

jordan: we rolled model-serving 1.3.2 at 13:40 UTC to improve throughput. Could be an interaction with batcher heuristics.

matt: logs show frequent large-batch hotpath + kernel fallback churn:
```
[2026-03-18T13:58:22Z] sidecar=batcher id=bc-7 error=slot_delay
kernel=auto -> slowpath quantization fallback
```

priya: if it's kernel fallback churn + kvcache misses, short-term we should divert traffic from the new variant to the previous stable variant and shrink batcher sizes. I can flip routing to fallback model in ~90s.

jordan: do it. Also start a kv-warm job for top prefixes.

priya: flipping route now -> `redwood route set --route /v1/generate --model redwood/textgen-1.3.1 --region us-west-2 --weight 100`

matt: applying batcher change to reduce tail:
```
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/batcher-ctrl -- sh -c "apply-config --batch-size=8 --max-wait-ms=20"
```

ops-bot: kv-warm job started: job/kv-warm-1758889990 (warming top-10 prefixes, ETA ~3m).

jordan: routing flip confirmed. Observability: p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 0.35s within 30s. p99 trending down from 3.6s -> 1.8s and still falling. No increase in 5xx observed.

pagerduty-bot: PD-81342 acknowledged by jordan.

sam: pinged for 30m handoff window, can pick up after.

priya: note for follow-up: investigate why 1.3.2 triggers kernel fallback under typical seq-length distribution (likely compilation/kernel selection bug or quantization path). Also review batcher heuristic change in deploy.

matt: agreed. I'll capture traces and open a jira: INFR-2048 with initial findings + stack traces.

jordan: customer-impact: small latency increase for a subset of us-west customers for ~25m. No data loss, no increased error rates. I'll update customer-impact channel.

sam: taking handoff. Please DM if any new alarms. I'll keep an eye for reversion or regression in the next 60m.

incident-bot: automatic metrics check: 15m stable window with p99 < 2.0s and SLO burn < 1% — scheduling PD auto-close in 10m unless re-opened.

jordan: :thumbsup: Good work. Leaving a short handover note in the runbook and capturing commands we ran. Postmortem owner: matt.

matt: will own INFR-2048. Action items: 1) revert or patch kernel selection in 1.3.2, 2) add safety-snooze to model-rollouts to prevent immediate tail regression, 3) add a metric for kernel-fallback-rate to alert earlier.

sam: ack, monitoring. If anything spikes I'll escalate.

incident-bot: PD-81342 closed automatically (stable).
